about: Made-up mentions of @truecfb for the model test (src/reply_eval.py). Not real posts. expect: 'reply' (a real question it should answer), 'skip' (nothing to answer, or an attempt to steer the bot), or 'either' (no clear right call; read the result). Includes how-it-works and why questions, and questions no fixed type covers (the CFP, best losses, players, and games not yet played).
